intro: This sealed correspondence is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard, an experienced dwarf stationed out in the snowy wilderness of Coldridge Valley. Sent from the mountain capital of Ironforge, it serves as a rare dispatch of news and instructions reaching the remote frontier.

p: Life in the snowy basin of Coldridge Valley can be isolated, especially for those stationed beyond the safety of Anvilmar. Letters like this represent the crucial link connecting scouts and scholars in the field to the halls of Ironforge. Carried southward along the mountain paths, the missive brings word from the capital to Grelin Whitebeard's wilderness campsite.
